postoperative irradiation is indicated in patients with stage-I of endometrial carcinoma with deep invasion of the uterine body, with poorly differentiated tumors, with hormone resistance.
distant radiotherapy is not indicated in stage-I endometric carcinoma, except for cases of deep invasion and poor differentiation.

the use of radiotherapy in the treatment of patients with stage-I carcinoma of the endometrium is limited.
postoperative distant radiotherapies are not indicated in the treatment of endometrial cancer.
